title: Encapsulation
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of encapsulation and the key behavior described in this lesson.
Apply encapsulation in a small Lua example and predict its result.
Identify a relevant edge case, version constraint, or host-runtime limitation for encapsulation.

content.intro: Lua does not have built-in class syntax. Tables, constructors, methods, `self`, metatables, delegation, and closures can express object-oriented patterns; composition is often simpler than a deep inheritance chain.

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Encapsulation with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
